issues: Document is a certification-body accreditation scope (ГОСТ Р ИСО/МЭК 17065-2012), not a testing-lab measurement scope: the table has no 'показатель/диапазон/единица' columns, so indicator/range_from/range_to/unit are null on every row by design (no data was invented). Column 5 ('Технические регламенты, документы... устанавливающие требования') was mapped to norm_doc; column 6 ('Документы, устанавливающие правила и методы исследований (испытаний) и измерений') has no dedicated schema field, so it is preserved only in raw_row_text (appended after norm_doc, separated by ' | '), joined internally with '; '. Each numbered row (А1.1-А1.32) is emitted as exactly one JSON row (no repeated indicators/ranges exist to split on). tr_section is the single section heading covering the whole table ('А1. Обязательная сертификация продукции требованиям Технических регламентов Евразийского экономического союза'); no other ТР ТС/раздел heading rows appear in the document (rows A1.23-A1.32 cite ТР ТС 032/2013 in column 5 as part of their normal document list, not as a separate full-width heading row). Page 1 is physically landscape/rotated in the source PDF but rendered upright and fully legible at 150dpi; no other rotation issues. All standard/GOST citations across the very long, multi-page-spanning column-5/column-6 lists for each object were transcribed by hand from the rendered page images; given the sheer volume (dozens to ~90 individual standard citations per row, spanning up to 4 pages each), occasional single-character OCR slips in a GOST/EN/ISO number cannot be fully ruled out despite careful manual review, but no content was invented and nothing was knowingly omitted. Final page (36) also carries the signature block (Генеральный директор АО ИТЦ «ДЭБ», Л. Г. Пауль) with no additional table rows.
